import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click the button to select project and create milestone
    select_project_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Select project to create milestone", exact=True)
    await select_project_button.click()
    # Wait for a dialog or form to appear
    try:
        await page.wait_for_selector('[role="dialog"]', timeout=10000)  # Wait for a dialog
    except:
        # If no dialog, maybe the form is on the same page
        pass
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait

    # Step 2: Fill in the milestone form
    # Look for input fields within the dialog or on the page
    # Title input
    title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title", exact=True).or_(page.get_by_label("Title", exact=True))
    await title_input.fill("Collective Code Review")

    # Start date input
    start_date_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Start date", exact=True).or_(page.get_by_label("Start date", exact=True))
    await start_date_input.fill("2023-01-16")

    # End date input
    end_date_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date", exact=True).or_(page.get_by_label("Due date", exact=True))
    await end_date_input.fill("2023-02-05")

    # Step 3: Submit the form
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create milestone", exact=True).or_(page.get_by_role("button", name="Save", exact=True))
    await submit_button.click()

    # Wait for the milestone to be created
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(3)

    # Step 4: Verify creation
    new_milestone_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Collective Code Review", exact=True)
    if await new_milestone_link.is_visible():
        print("Milestone 'Collective Code Review' created successfully.")
    else:
        print("Milestone creation may have failed.")
